docstring:
If $A \subset \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ is random, $|A| = \sqrt{p}$, can we almost surely cover
$\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ with $100\sqrt{p}$ translates of $A$? [Gr24]
references: [BJR11] Bollobás, Béla, Svante Janson, and Oliver Riordan. "On covering by translates of a set." Random Structures & Algorithms 38.1‐2 (2011): 33-67.
type_pretty:
True ↔
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun p =>
      have k := (↑p).sqrt;
      have c := 100 * k;
      ↑(Green39.proportionCoverable (↑p) k c))
    Filter.atTop (nhds 1)
